integrity: The core proof is an exact nonconstant conditional-Gaussian variance argument for all finite sites and parameter ranges; computational checks are partial, not an infinite proof. Independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite integer chain lengths N>=2, positive wall diffusivity/reset rates, positive mass/stiffness/friction, independent nonnegative endpoint Gaussian heating. No N->infinity scaling, non-Poisson clocks, zero-wall-diffusivity boundaries or quantitative finite-sample power. Earlier four-time wall cumulant known (Knight et al. 2025), earlier numerical velocity non-Gaussianity known (Sarkar and Roy 2023).
title: Strict non-Gaussian velocity fluctuations at every site of a reset-driven harmonic chain
